mechanism_narrative: The steady improvement in WORKPLACES mobility from -49.4 to -22.3 over the last two weeks signals a return of commuting routines that will lift weekday retail footfall, producing higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days in more than 50% of instances where WORKPLACES rose for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility crossing above -30 (now -26.1) indicates increased station usage and broader reopening, which historically leads retail-and-recreation footfall by two weeks, driving RETAIL_REC upward.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the two weeks following a TRANSIT reading above -30.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction of PARKS rising above 0 and GROCERY_PHARM staying above 5 signals a shift to outdoor social and local shopping activity, which spills over into retail-and-recreation venues, raising RETAIL_REC.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines over the next two weeks despite PARKS > 0 and GROCERY_PHARM > 5 being observed.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL exceeds 10 and WORKPLACES falls below -30, a tightening-restrictions regime is active, keeping people at home and suppressing retail-and-recreation mobility, so RETAIL_REC declines over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next week when RESIDENTIAL > 10 and WORKPLACES < -30 are simultaneously observed.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated GROCERY_PHARM above 8 reflects pandemic stockpiling and local errand concentration, which substitutes for retail-and-recreation trips, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Seasonal winter conditions marked by PARKS declining below -10 reduce outdoor leisure and discretionary shopping, depressing RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks relative to the last four.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days when PARKS is below -10.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES rising above -25 indicates a rapid return to offices, which immediately boosts lunchtime and after-work retail activity, lifting RETAIL_REC within one week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC falls over the next week after WORKPLACES rises above -25.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction of high RESIDENTIAL (above 9) and low TRANSIT (below -30) signals a stay-at-home regime that starves retail venues of foot traffic, driving RETAIL_REC down over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days when RESIDENTIAL > 9 and TRANSIT < -30 are simultaneously observed.
